column2: If someone laughs after surprising them they have a good sense of what? How might an automobile get off a freeway?
Where would you store a pillow case that is not in use? Where might the stapler be if I cannot find it?
How many hours are in a day? What geographic area is a lizard likely to be?
Where is a well used toy car likely to be found? Where may you be if you're buying pork chops at a corner shop?
What can you use to store a book while traveling? On a hot day what can you do to enjoy something cool and sweet?
